capabilities: search podcasts by keyword, YouTube link, Apple Podcasts page, or audio URL
fetch full episode transcripts, reusing existing captions or transcribing locally with faster-whisper
save transcripts as notes with front matter recording source, quality, and date
follow favorite podcasts pinned in a personal list
batch-fetch transcripts by pasting one link or title per line
extras: Desktop only (Windows/macOS/Linux); requires Python and runs a local helper that creates an isolated venv at ~/.longhai-podscript installing yt-dlp and faster-whisper; nothing is uploaded. Detailed install and usage guide is written in Chinese. Community-marketplace install was still pending review at time of writing, with BRAT and manual install offered as alternatives. Transcripts are drafts that may contain errors in names, terms, and punctuation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to obtain full podcast transcripts, and existing routes usually need paid transcription APIs or external tools.
